text: NH-3 highway completely blocked near Aut due to landslide and flooding. Hundreds of vehicles stranded. No passage since yesterday morning.
Larji village almost submerged. Residents on rooftops requesting immediate evacuation. Power lines down. No mobile connectivity.
Paddhar community health centre flooded. Patients and staff evacuated to higher ground. Medical supplies damaged.
Beas river bridge at Mandi town under threat. Water level 2 metres above danger mark. District administration urging evacuation of low-lying areas.
Kullu town markets flooded knee-deep. Several shops and houses damaged along the riverside. Relief camps set up at government school.
Bajaura village road washed away. Around 3 families reported missing. No response on phones. Last contact 36 hours ago.
Sundernagar district experiencing heavy waterlogging but situation manageable. Local administration distributed food packets to 200 families.
Bhuntar airport flooded, operations suspended. Helipad still operational. Emergency medical helicopter requested for Larji.
No news from Banjar tehsil for past 2 days. All roads blocked. Phone towers not working. Army column sent but could not reach.
Aut hydropower project site partially damaged. Workers evacuated. Project under observation for structural integrity.
